messages:
ana: Quick sync — ACME POC perf run completed. We hit a blocker from their security team (SQA) about private deployment audit and they're asking for throughput guarantees. Also two pricing Qs (burst vs committed) pending. Need perf notes and a recommended load plan to share with them before EOD. Can SEs + perf own?

mike: I'll own load plan. Suggest 3 phases:
- smoke: 10m at 50 qps
- ramp: 30m up to 400 qps
- soak: 2h at target 250 qps
Use a sample of ~200 prompt variants, target mean seq len 128. KV cache OFF during ramp to measure worst-case; then repeat with cache ON for realistic savings. Warmup 5 mins. Any objections?

jorge: Sounds good. Quick note from today's run on dedicated-8x: 30m ramp test results:
p50=95ms, p95=180ms, p99=420ms, p99.9=980ms
sustained peak 350 qps, error rate ~0.12% (mostly 5xx) during spikes.
Token estimate: ~0.0025 USD/token (internal calc) — will refine.
Logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-16T14:23:10Z] qps=320 inflight=45 node=worker-3 p95=175ms
[2026-03-16T14:24:32Z] ERROR worker-3 OOM reconnect
[2026-03-16T14:25:00Z] qps=340 inflight=40 p95=182ms
```
We saw 2.1x throughput improvement when KV cache hit rate >40%.

mike: Good data. How reproducible is the run? Any env flakiness to call out?

jorge: Reproducible after we cycled worker-3; the OOM seems tied to a bad memory accounting path on one AMI. Fix is to bump worker memory and enable health-check restart threshold. I'll run a 1h reproducible soak tomorrow and share sanitized logs.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary run for this config on 2026-03-17T18:00:00Z UTC — notifies #eng-runtime and #eng-sre

liz: For SQA items: they asked for KMS support details, audit-log retention (want 1y), and SOC2 evidence. We have SOC2 in progress; can provide control summary and expected completion date. SEs — can we produce a sanitized sample audit log (no customer PII)? Also need a simple KMS architecture diagram.

mike: We can export a sanitized audit log and create a KMS diagram (tenant keys + envelope encryption). On pricing: recommend offering committed monthly with a small baseline, plus a burst pool. Burst billing: per-minute metered at ~2x hosted per-token rate; reserved commit gets 15-25% discount depending on term. I'll draft a pricing blurb for the email.

ana: ACME asked for a written 99.9% latency SLO at 200 qps. Feasible?

jorge: With KV cache warmed and autoscale headroom, 99.9% < 700ms at 200 qps is realistic. Without cache, expect 99.9% ~1.1s. Recommend we promise SLO with conditions: pre-warm, documented prompt profile, and a canary before cutover. Also recommend 30% autoscale margin for spikes.

ana: Action items:
- mike: share load plan doc + pricing blurb (by EOD)
- jorge: run 1h soak, produce sanitized logs + p95/p99 matrix (tomorrow)
- liz: prepare KMS diagram + SOC2 control summary (48h)
- ana: draft the response/email to ACME and include these artifacts
Thanks — this should unblock their procurement/security sync. :pray:
